blocks.remarksEn:
The Major 'Energy, Ecology and Climate' is one of the three majors you can choose during your programme. In the overview below you can see all the courses that are part of this major. This major consists of two tracks: Energy Transition and Earth & Environment.
Please pay attention to individual prerequisites of courses since these are binding.

course.titleEn: Data for Future Energy and Climate (200)
Homes and Cars: Technologies, Citizens and the Energy Transition (100)
Climate Change: Land, Earth and Water (200)
course.titleNl: Climate Change: Land, Earth and Water (200)

blocks.remarksEn:
The major 'Politics, Philosophy and Economics' is one of the three majors you can choose during your programme. In the overview below you can see all the courses that are part of this major.  This major consists of two tracks: Economics and Political Science.
Please pay attention to individual prerequisites of courses since these are binding.

blocks.specializationTitleEn: Major Culture, Psychology and Global Health
blocks.specializationTitleNl: Major Culture, Psychology and Global Health
blocks.remarksEn:
The major 'Culture, Psychology and Global Health' is one of the three majors you can choose during your programme. In the overview below you can see all the courses that are part of this major. This major consists of two tracks: Psychology and Culture and Global Health.
Please pay attention to individual prerequisites of courses since these are binding.

! For students of cohort 2023 and older, the courses Local Cultures and Global Commodities and Ethnographic Theory and Practice are not part of this major but are 'Optional Electives' in the Culture Track (see also Ocasys 2024-2025)

course.titleEn: Language, Culture and Meaning: Introduction to Linguistic Anthropology (200)
Psychological Perspectives on Leadership and Organizations (200)
course.titleNl: Psychological Perspectives on Leadership and Organizations (200)

course.titleEn: Worldwide Analyses of Global Health Issues (300)
